stories.title: OpenAI 宣称解决千禧年数学难题，学术界感到寒意
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
stories.summary: OpenAI 周二宣布解决了一个著名的千禧年数学难题，这本应是胜利时刻；结果既展示 AI 正快速改变数学，也在学术界引发不安。
stories.analysis: 若属实，这将把 AI 的数学推理能力推到新高度，同时加剧对学术评价与原创性归属的讨论。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI's announcement Tuesday that it has solved one of mathematics' legendary Millennium Prize problems should have been a moment of triumph. The result is both an undeniable achievement and a striking demonstration of just how rapidly AI is transforming math

stories.title: 马萨诸塞州出台数据中心清洁电力新规，三个月内第三个州收紧限制
stories.sourceTitle: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
stories.summary: 马萨诸塞州成为三个月内第三个对数据中心开发施加新限制的州，新规聚焦清洁电力要求。
stories.analysis: AI 算力扩张正遭遇地方能源与环保政策压力，数据中心选址和供电成本可能上升。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Massachusetts has become the third state in as many months to slap new restrictions on data center development.

stories.title: 苹果发布文档说明 Siri 新听觉功能如何保护隐私
stories.sourceTitle: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy
stories.summary: 苹果在 iPhone Duo 发布会上推出 Siri Recap、Live Rewind、声音识别和音乐识别等 AI 音频智能功能，并同步发布文档解释隐私保护方式。
stories.analysis: 始终在听的 AI 功能越普及，苹果越需要用可验证的隐私设计来换取用户信任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At Wednesday's iPhone Duo launch event, Apple announced a handful of new Siri AI Audio Intelligence features, including Siri Recap, Live Rewind, Sound Recognition, and Music Recognition. Alongside its announcement, Apple released a document laying out how it p

stories.title: Suno 发布 v6 AI 音乐模型，首次获唱片业支持并改用新训练数据
stories.sourceTitle: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
stories.summary: Suno 推出 v6 AI 音乐模型，称其从零训练，使用与旧模型不同的新数据集，并首次得到唱片行业支持。
stories.analysis: 版权争议中的 AI 音乐公司正试图用授权数据和产业合作换取合法性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Suno's new v6 AI music model is its first made with support from the record industry. Suno's Jack Brody told The Verge that v6 was "trained from the ground up, with a new set of data that does not include the same data that our previous models were trained on.

stories.title: Listen Labs 为与 Salesforce 谈判，放弃 15 亿美元融资轮
stories.sourceTitle: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
stories.summary: 消息人士称，AI 研究初创公司 Listen Labs 放弃了 Menlo Ventures 已签署的 C 轮投资条款，转而与 Salesforce 谈判。
stories.analysis: 大厂战略投资或收购可能比纯财务融资更具吸引力，也反映 AI 研究资产争夺激烈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

stories.title: Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会及安全委员会
stories.sourceTitle: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布 AI 对齐与安全研究者 Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会，并进入其安全与安保委员会。
stories.analysis: 在安全争议和治理压力下，OpenAI 借知名对齐研究者强化安全叙事。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.

stories.title: OpenAI 将知名 AI 安全研究者 Paul Christiano 纳入董事会
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，专注对齐研究、常被归为 AI 末日论者的 Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会。
stories.analysis: 这显示 OpenAI 在加速能力的同时，也需要安放来自安全阵营的制衡声音。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.

stories.title: 苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 推出 Reference Image，证明照片非 AI 篡改
stories.sourceTitle: Apple’s new iPhone camera mode promises to prove your photo isn’t AI
stories.summary: 苹果将在本月晚些时候随 iPhone 18 Pro 系列推出 Reference Image 功能，利用新相机传感器为照片签名，以证明其并非 AI 操纵。
stories.analysis: 在 AI 生成内容泛滥后，硬件级内容溯源可能成为手机影像的新竞争点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple is launching a new way to prove that the picture you took isn't manipulated by AI. A new feature, called "Reference Image," will arrive with the iPhone 18 Pro lineup later this month and is supposed to use the device's new camera sensor to "sign every pi

stories.title: Microsoft 与 AFT 达成校园 AI 安全与隐私原则
stories.sourceTitle: Microsoft has new AI privacy rules for schools
stories.summary: 在两个大型学区禁止面向学生的 AI 一周后，微软与美国教师联合会 AFT 达成校园 AI 安全与隐私原则。
stories.analysis: 校园 AI 落地需要先解决隐私和信任问题，微软此举意在争取教育市场合法性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft agreed to a set of safety and privacy principles for AI in schools a week after two major school systems announced a ban on student-facing AI. In a new agreement with the American Federation of Teachers (AFT), the second-largest teachers union in the

stories.title: Apple Watch 新 AI 功能引发“始终在听”隐私争议
stories.sourceTitle: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
stories.summary: 苹果称新手表不会保存原始音频，但可转录近期语音和总结环境对话的功能，重新引发关于同意、隐私和随时可能被录音的讨论。
stories.analysis: 当可穿戴设备持续感知环境，产品体验与隐私边界将更难平衡。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.

stories.title: 苹果秋季发布会汇总：折叠屏 iPhone Duo 与始终在听的 Apple Watch
stories.sourceTitle: Everything Apple announced at its fall iPhone event, from the foldable iPhone Duo to an always-listening Apple Watch
stories.summary: 苹果秋季 iPhone 发布会主角是首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo，同时推出具备始终在听能力的 Apple Watch 等新品。
stories.analysis: 苹果正把 AI 感知能力嵌入硬件生态，但折叠屏和隐私问题同样考验市场接受度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The main event was the tech giant's highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

stories.title: Amazon Prime Video 用 AI 让配音口型与音频同步
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon Prime Video’s new AI tech matches lips to dubbed audio
stories.summary: Prime Video 推出 AI 功能，将演员嘴型与人工配音音频对齐，目前仅用于德语剧《Maxton Hall》的英语配音，后续计划扩展。
stories.analysis: AI 配音本地化能降低影视出海成本，但口型同步效果将决定观众是否买账。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon's Prime Video is launching a new AI-powered feature that lines up an actor's mouth with "human-dubbed" audio. The feature is only available with the English dub of the German series Maxton Hall for now, but Prime Video plans to expand it to "additional

stories.title: OECD 报告：用 AI 辅助学习的学生成绩通常更差
stories.sourceTitle: Students who use AI generally score worse at school
stories.summary: OECD 全球教育报告数据显示，用 AI 辅助学习的学生成绩通常低于不用 AI 的学生，但某些类型的使用能带来轻微提升。
stories.analysis: AI 教育工具的效果高度依赖使用方式，不能简单视为提分捷径。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Students who use AI to help them study tend to perform worse at school than those who don't, according to data from a global OECD educational report. The situation is more complex than it sounds though, with certain types of AI use giving learners a slight boo

stories.title: 苹果首款折叠屏手机的铰链制造借助 AI 和 3D 打印
stories.sourceTitle: The hinge for Apple’s new foldable phone was built with AI
stories.summary: 苹果表示，其首款折叠屏手机的制造过程使用了 AI 和 3D 打印技术，尤其是铰链部分。
stories.analysis: AI 正从功能层渗透到制造工艺，折叠屏可靠性或成为差异化关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple says it used AI and 3D printing in the manufacturing process for its long-awaited foldable phone.

stories.title: 苹果新版 Health 应用用 Apple Intelligence 计算“健康年龄”和准备度评分
stories.sourceTitle: Apple’s revamped Health app will calculate your ‘health age’ and readiness score
stories.summary: 苹果改版 Health 应用，借助 Apple Intelligence 理解健康数据，并计算用户的“健康年龄”和 readiness score。
stories.analysis: 健康评分若缺乏医学验证，可能带来激励与误导并存的争议。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The update uses Apple Intelligence to make better sense of your health data.

stories.title: 苹果推出 Apple Reference Image，证明 iPhone 照片非 AI 生成
stories.sourceTitle: Apple has a new way to prove your iPhone photos aren’t AI slop
stories.summary: 苹果推出 Apple Reference Image，帮助用户判断照片是否经过编辑，包括 AI 修改。
stories.analysis: 内容真实性验证正成为手机厂商的新卖点，也可能推动行业溯源标准。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users determine whether photos have been edited, including alterations made by AI.

stories.title: 苹果 CEO John Ternus：最好的 AI 设备仍是 iPhone
stories.sourceTitle: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
stories.summary: 苹果 CEO John Ternus 称最好的 AI 设备仍是 iPhone，并强调端侧模型能为消费者提供更多隐私。
stories.analysis: 苹果把 AI 竞争拉回硬件与端侧隐私，试图对冲云端大模型优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.

stories.title: Google Search 新增橄榄球功能：实时赛况、数据和梦幻推荐
stories.sourceTitle: Get ready for the game with new football features in Search
stories.summary: Google Search 推出新赛季橄榄球功能，用户可直接追踪实时赛况、查看详细数据和获取定制梦幻推荐。
stories.analysis: 搜索正借体育等实时场景增强 AI 个性化，以提升用户粘性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Track live game feeds, explore detailed stats, and get custom fantasy recommendations directly in Search this season.

stories.title: OpenAI 的 Chris Lehane：AI 政策窗口已打开，需要立即行动
stories.sourceTitle: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
stories.summary: OpenAI 的 Chris Lehane 主张，AI 能力越强，越需要更强的安全证据、共享标准和持久政策行动，并呼吁抓住当前政策窗口。
stories.analysis: OpenAI 正主动参与规则制定，以影响未来 AI 监管框架。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.

stories.title: Google DeepMind 用 AI 逐帧重现 70 年爱情故事
stories.sourceTitle: Recreating a 70-year love story frame by frame
stories.summary: 电影制作人与 Google DeepMind 合作，在短片《Love, Rendered》中用 AI 重现一对夫妇未被记录下来的过往。
stories.analysis: AI 视频生成正进入叙事创作，但历史再现的伦理和真实性仍待讨论。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."

stories.title: 超级智能即将到来，我们该允许它吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Superintelligence is coming. Should we let it?
stories.summary: TechCrunch 讨论超级智能 AI 是否不可避免，并提到 OpenAI 的 Hugging Face 入侵等安全事件，显示部署超越人类能力的 AI 可能带来危险。
stories.analysis: 安全事件频发会让“能力优先”路线面临更严格的公众审视。

stories.title: ControlAI 的 Connor Leahy：超级智能“不是武器，而是对手”
stories.sourceTitle: ControlAI’s Connor Leahy on why superintelligence is ‘not a weapon, it’s an adversary’
stories.summary: ControlAI 的 Connor Leahy 在采访中表示，超级智能不应被当作武器，而更像一个对手，并引用近期安全事件说明风险。
stories.analysis: 这种框架强调治理需要把超级智能视为不可控主体，而非单纯工具。

stories.title: 病毒式 AI 助手 Instinct 现在有自己的电子邮箱地址
stories.sourceTitle: Viral AI assistant Instinct now has its own email address
stories.summary: Instinct 推出新邮件功能，让 AI agent 能创建和管理账户、联系商家、处理客服请求，并代表用户执行更多操作。
stories.analysis: 给 AI agent 独立邮箱意味着它正从聊天工具变成能自主行动的数字代理。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Instinct’s new email feature lets the AI agent create and manage accounts, contact businesses, handle support requests, and do more on users' behalf.

stories.title: Anthropic 研究员 Jacob Coxon 辞职，警告自我改进 AI 风险
stories.sourceTitle: ‘Gambling with our lives’: Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
stories.summary: Anthropic 研究员 Jacob Coxon 因担心 AI 灭绝风险辞职，并呼吁各实验室达成节奏控制协议。
stories.analysis: 内部研究者公开离职警告，可能加剧对 AI 自我改进和安全承诺的质疑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned over AI extinction fears, calling for pacing agreements between labs.

stories.title: Shipt 推出 AI 购物助手，可自动生成购物车
stories.sourceTitle: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
stories.summary: 配送应用 Shipt 新增 AI 购物助手，用户可要求它为 25 人周末尾门派对或学校午餐生成购物车。
stories.analysis: 电商配送的 AI 助手正从推荐商品走向代用户完成复杂购物任务。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Users can ask the assistant to do things like "Create a cart for my Saturday tailgate for 25 people and include some brunch items," or "Build a cart for easy school lunches and after-school snacks," Shipt says.

stories.analysis: 高价折叠屏加 AI 设计叙事，是苹果在硬件创新放缓下的一次新尝试。
